proposal.summary: Dispute ticket volume doubled from ~610 in June/July to 1,180 in August and 1,260 in September, indicating a billing issue that generates incorrect bills. Root cause identified as changes to billing import validation rules after August causing systematic mis‑billing. Evidence shows the ticket surge (E-01), disputed bills split between estimated and actual reads (E-04), and high‑consumption AMI read rejections (E-10) that point to rule‑change‑driven mis‑billing; hypothesis H‑BILLING‑RULE‑CHANGE is confirmed with E-04 and E-10. The released capability monitors dispute ticket volume daily (action: monitor_dispute_volume on DA‑TICKET) to track return to pre‑August baseline. Release is granted as a known‑limitation release because the scope only provides monitoring; it does not include the required actions to identify and revert the billing import validation rule changes that are the root cause.
